Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized administrator account in Nurses BD, keyed by lowercase verified Google email.

email.description: Lowercase Google account email address matching the document ID.

role.description: Administrative privilege level (SUPER_ADMIN or Divisional MODERATOR).

assignedDivision.description: Assigned Bangladesh division or All Bangladesh.

addedBy.description: Email or system identifier of the creator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on updates.

Nurse.title: Nurse
Nurse.description: Registered Bangladesh nurse/midwife/student directory profile and approval workflow record.

submittedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitting user or seeding admin.

nurseCategory.description: Employment/academic category: Govt. Nurse/Midwife, Non-Govt. Nurse/Midwife, or Student Nurse/Midwife.

bnmcNumber.description: BNMC Registration No. (or Student Registration No. for Student Nurse/Midwife) (4 to 30 characters).

govtUid.description: Government service UID / Employee ID for employed government nurses (0 to 40 characters).

designation.description: Nursing role title (e.g., Senior Staff Nurse, Midwife, Student Nurse) (2 to 60 characters).

educations.description: Structured list of educational courses (courseName, major, university, passedYear).

upazila.description: Bangladesh upazila or thana name (0 to 50 characters).

address.description: Present residential address (mandatory for Non-Govt when workplace is optional; 0 to 200 characters).

hospitalName.description: Hospital/workplace or Educational Institute (mandatory for Govt & Student; optional for Non-Govt; 0 to 120 characters).

phone.description: Bangladeshi contact phone number (11 to 20 characters).

availabilityStatus.description: Current shift or emergency availability status.

bio.description: Short clinical summary or shift notes (0 to 400 characters).

approvalStatus.description: Admin moderation status; new non-admin registrations always start as PENDING.

reviewedBy.description: Email of the reviewing administrator (optional until reviewed).

reviewedAt.description: Server timestamp of admin review via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() (optional until reviewed).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on submission.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on modification.

TransferRequest.title: TransferRequest
TransferRequest.description: Nurse hospital transfer or Non-Govt to Govt service transfer request submitted by the nurse owner for admin approval.

LiveNotice.title: LiveNotice
LiveNotice.description: Real-time directory broadcast banner updated by admins without APK re-downloads.

/admins/{adminEmail}.description: Role-based access registry of administrators keyed by verified lowercase Google email.

/nurses/{nurseId}.description: Registered nurses, midwives, and student nurses directory across Bangladesh with approval workflow.

/transfer_requests/{requestId}.description: Hospital transfer and Non-Govt to Govt transfer requests initiated by approved nurses and approved/rejected by admins.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Live remote configuration and admin announcement notice synced across all app installs.
